Name: Keyblades
Author: Lucidvisionsinc
Description:
[center][/center][center]🗝️ Keyblade Mod - Unleash Your Inner Hero!
Discover a world of magic and adventure with the Keyblade Mod! Embark on a thrilling journey as you wield powerful keyblades inspired by iconic characters from various universes. Are you ready to save the day?

Features:
Introducing a captivating array of keyblades, each with unique designs and abilities.
 Dive into the enchanting Cape Stardew Map to find these legendary weapons.
 Unleash your magic abilities to enhance your combat prowess!

Multiplayer Compatibility:
Should work normally. Report any bugs in the bugs tab.[/center]

Downloads.Description:
- Lowered the volume of all 24 WAV sound effects by 6 dB for a more consistent listening level.

Fixed all 10 Keyblade Precision values, scaling them to Stardew’s 7–10 range. Replaced the CPA animation with SpaceCore TextureOverrides.
